title: Yummy British Pork Bake
description: A deliciously citrusy and crispy British-style pork dish from Northern Ireland that's perfect for a lazy Sunday meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the pork chunks with the olive oil, thyme, and rosemary until evenly coated.
Heat a large oven-safe pan over medium-high heat. Add the pork and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pan and sauté until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the mixed carrots and parsnips, mirin-hon, lemon zest, and lemon juice to the pan, stirring to combine.
Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, add the halved cherry tomatoes to the pan and continue baking for another 15 minutes.
While the pork is baking, roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of about 3mm (1/8 inch).
Once the pork is done, remove it from the oven and carefully place the puff pastry on top of the pork, pressing the edges to seal.
Return the pan to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove the pan from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
